**About us:**
Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success.
  
  
We're building a different kind of system—in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today.
  
  
What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along.

Rev-Ops sits between BD, Account Management, Merchant Ops, Churn, CRM and Channel Partners. We are the team that makes commercial data trustworthy and commercial processes repeatable, and ensure pipelines that reflect reality, dashboards leadership can act on, and the automation that keeps both current.

* **Allocation hygiene.**

* **Reporting and dashboards.**

* **CRM process migration.**
  Help move operational processes that still live in sheets and email into the CRM, and make the teams actually adopt them.
* **Automation.**
  Automate the repetitive parts of the above, so recurring work stops consuming a person.
* **Cross-functional unblocking.**
  Work across Sales, Finance, Product, Risk and Merchant Ops to resolve operational issues, and follow them to closure rather than handing them off.
* **Special Projects.**
  You will be part of the core working group that focuses on BD & AM initiatives we label as special projects. This can include unlocking new industries, GTM for new products, launching new regions, churn operations or optimizing our existing product at a large scale.

* 2 - 4 years in commercial operations, revenue operations, sales operations, or product operations/product management or business/data analysis in a commercial function.
* Advanced English, written and spoken. You will write for leadership.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets - Apps Script, AppSheet, pivots, lookups, building a working model without supervision.
* Hands-on experience with at least one CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics, Zoho or similar): maintaining data quality, building views and reports, and working with the people who configure it.
* Comfortable building dashboards and reports in a BI tool (Tableau, Power BI or similar).
* Practical use of AI tools
